中文 (Chinese)：

簡易藍圖 (獨立版)

你是否喜歡 Create: The Brass Concerto 整合包中便捷的 工程集合 功能，但又不想被整合包的其他內容所束縛？

本模組正是為此而生！在獲得原整合包作者正式授權的前提下，我將該功能完整剝離，重構成一個獨立的模組。

功能特性：

  • 獨立運行：僅需 Create 模組作為前置，無需安裝 Andesite Abound。

  • 核心玩法：保留 工程集合 的核心物品，致力於簡化機械動力中的建築與材料準備流程。

  • 輕量級：專注於單一功能，無多餘程式碼，相容性更強。

致謝：
感謝 Apertyotis 的創意與慷慨授權，讓這一優秀功能得以惠及更多玩家。

English (英文):

Simple Schematic (Standalone)

Do you enjoy the convenient "Simple Schematic" feature from the Create: The Brass Concerto modpack, but prefer not to be tied down by the rest of the pack?

This mod is the solution! With official permission from the original modpack author, this feature has been completely extracted and refactored into a standalone mod.

Features:

  • Standalone Operation: Requires only Create as a dependency; no need for Andesite Abound.

  • Core Gameplay: Retains the core mechanics of "Simple Schematic," focusing on simplifying the building and material preparation process in Create.

  • Lightweight: Focuses on a single feature with no bloat code, ensuring better compatibility.

Acknowledgments:
Thanks to Apertyotis for the original idea and generous permission, allowing this great feature to benefit more players.
